candidate_mechanisms.why: Very bright tubulin with thick bundles, rings/cages around nuclei and saturated round cells, plus irregular lobed nuclei and rounded mitotic-like cells, matching increased tubulin mean and texture and decreased nuclear roundness.

notable_cells.why: Cluster of adherent cells with circular tubulin cages/wheels around lobed blue DNA, example of bundle phenotype.
Adherent cell with bright green tubulin ring around dark nucleus and red actin rim, plus nearby saturated round yellow cells.
Spread cell with radial starburst tubulin bundles around irregular nucleus.
Group of cells with thick green tubulin bundles and irregular condensed DNA, plus small bright round cells.

observations.finding: Tubulin markedly brighter than DMSO, with thick bundles, rings/cages and saturated white round cells vs dim diffuse DMSO. Agrees with tub_mean z 29.7, value 0.697 vs 0.262.
Tubulin texture highly heterogeneous with sharp bright-dark transitions and coarse bundles. Agrees with tub_glcm_contrast z 115 and tub_std z 37.7.
Nuclei irregular, lobed, fragmented and eccentric, less round/solid than uniform round DMSO nuclei. Agrees with nuc_form_factor z -23.8, nuc_solidity z -21.7, nuc_eccentricity z 9.1.
DNA intensity overall dimmer with mix of small condensed bright dots and larger pale irregular nuclei. Agrees with nuc_dna_mean z -8.7, value 0.348 vs 0.456.
Actin brighter with broad flat extensions and peripheral ruffles/spikes. Agrees with act_mean z 6.1, value 0.505 vs 0.274.
Many small rounded yellow-green (tubulin+actin bright) detached cells suggestive of mitotic arrest, and overall sparse fields vs dense DMSO monolayer; no direct mitotic-count measurement provided.

report.uncertainty: DMSO control composite and grayscale images are severely blurred/out-of-focus, limiting detailed cytoskeletal comparison; spindle polarity and chromosome alignment cannot be resolved to exclude other mitotic MoAs.

review.critique: Top call of Microtubule Stabilizers is well-supported across 4 wells at dose 5 twice and doses 6–7: the phenotype is not just an increase in microtubule intensity, it is increased tubule mean with bundled, coarse structuring that breaks down into the low-dimensional molecular signature. The runner-ups (Microtubule Destabilizers, Aurora kinase inhibitors, and Eg5 inhibitors) do not explain that increased polymer-like texture together with bundled perinuclear rings as well as the top class does, even allowing for the reduced strength in the dose 5 replicate.

protocol.protocol: 1-NN per acquired well, majority vote (NSC, Ljosa et al. 2013)

reflection.text:
The call was correct because three independent lines converged: extreme tubulin texture and intensity increases, microscopist description of bundled microtubules, and unanimous 4/4 NSC atlas votes for Microtubule stabilizers. The strongest discriminators were tub_glcm_contrast z +104 to +115 with tub_std z +32 to +39 and tub_mean z +25 to +30 across doses 5-7, which reads as more and coarser polymer rather than microtubule loss.

Sampling high dose first then mid-dose and a mid-dose replicate was efficient: it showed dose-persistence and reproducibility despite the replicate w_1c56739be6 having lower similarity (0.647) and a nucleus-dominated profile. The persistent 4/10 k-neighbour votes for destabilizers were a useful warning that intensity/texture alone partially overlaps stabilizer and destabilizer neighbours.

Unblinding as docetaxel with ChEMBL Tubulin stabiliser agrees with the phenotype-first call and required no revision of the protocol conclusion.
what_was_right: Interpreted very high tub_glcm_contrast (+108 to +115) plus high tub_std and tub_mean as bundled stabilized polymer, not depolymerization
Used describe_phenotype density-lower with bundled morphology to favor Microtubule stabilizers at 0.85 then 0.93 over destabilizers, Aurora and Eg5
Used compare_to_reference_atlas NSC 2/2 then 4/4 vote to lock the call despite kNN split 6/10 vs 4/10
what_was_wrong: Underestimated the stabilizer vs destabilizer neighbour overlap: 4/10 k-neighbours were Microtubule destabilizers in both atlas comparisons, so texture similarity alone was less specific than the NSC vote

Replicate w_1c56739be6 (dose 5 rep 2) shifted to nuclear shape features nuc_solidity z=-33.4 and frac_large_nucleus z=+21.3 with lower stabilizer similarity 0.647, which could have supported Aurora/Eg5 mitotic arrest if atlas voting had not been unanimous

citations.claim: Taxanes stabilize microtubules, supporting docetaxel as a microtubule stabilizer.
Taxanes target microtubules, consistent with increased tubulin intensity and bundling phenotype.
Microtubule-stabilizing agents represent a distinct anticancer mechanism defined by increased polymer stability.

reflection.next_experiment: Cell-free tubulin polymerization assay with docetaxel vs paclitaxel and nocodazole controls, plus washout in cells with phospho-histone H3 mitotic index to confirm stabilized polymer persists after washout.
